newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-SHINE POLISHES OFF ESSEX WITH FIVE WICKETS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SHINE POLISHES OFF ESSEX WITH FIVE WICKETS.

text.p: Paceman Kevin Shine jolted Essex's county championship title hopes with a five-wicket haul to guide Somerset to a crushing 10-wicket victory at Chelmsford on Friday.
The 28-year-old paceman, recently awarded his county cap, returned figures of five for 72 from 19 overs as Essex were shot out for 129 in their second innings after trailing by 109 in their first.

Australian Stuart Law was the only batsman to offer any serious resistance, but his 55 was not enough to avoid the inevitable. Graham Gooch (23) was the only other Essex player to reach double figures.
It left Glamorgan looking poised to go top of the table after completely dominating the third day of their clash with Gloucestershire at Swansea.

With leaders Middlesex struggling against Lancashire and second place Essex losing in three days, the Welsh county will be confident of taking advantage after forcing their visitors to follow on 186 runs behind.

Hugh Morris smacked 173 as Glamorgan declared on 400 for five 35 minutes before lunch and then bowled out Gloucester for 214. Gloucester were 54 for one in their second innings at the close, still 132 runs behind.
South African fast bowler Allan Donald bowled Warwickshire to the brink of victory with a season's best six for 55 as Surrey collapsed at Edgbaston.

Donald, playing his first championship game in five weeks after recovering from a back injury, sent Surrey crashing from 87-1 to 144 all out, wrecking the innings with five wickets for eight runs in a devastating 28-ball spell.
He finished with match figures of 10-119, the eighth 10- wicket haul of his career, and his six second innings wickets brought him his 49th five-wicket haul in first-class cricket.

Surrey's collapse left Warwickshire needing only 32 for victory but they were unable to complete a three-day win as they lost four quick wickets and will need nine more runs when the game resumes on Saturday.
